definitions.full: H537. amelal אֻמְלַל adjective id. (Ew ib. Sta § 230 ); ׳א אָ֫נִי Psa 6:3 (|| עֲצָמָ֑י נִבְהֲלוּ ). I. אמם (perhaps be wide, roomy , Assyrian [ am¹mu whence ummu , womb, mother = אֵם compare Dl Pr 109 ; but אֵם n.prim. according to Thes Sta § 189 b Lag BN 22 ).
